blocks.text: Aayein chalti hui body ki kinetic energy ka formula nikalein. Ek car sarak par constant speed se chal rahi hai. Agar engine band (OFF) kar dein to bhi woh rukne se pehle kuch faasla tay karti hai. Jab tak woh chal rahi hai, sarak ki friction (ragar) ke khilaf work kar rahi hai; yani is dauran woh friction f ke barabar force lagati hai. Agar rukne tak faasla d ho to car ka work fd hai. Yeh work car apni motion ki wajah se karti hai, aur motion ki wajah se work karne ki capacity hi kinetic energy hai. Is liye car ki kinetic energy fd ke barabar hai. Acceleration Newton ke second law se nikalti hai:
Car aahista hoti hai aur ruk jati hai, is liye us ki acceleration a negative hai, kyun ke yeh friction f se paida hoti hai jo motion ke opposite (ulat) lagti hai. To:

Kinetic energy us work ke barabar hai jo body kar sakti hai, is liye kinetic energy ka unit bhi work wala hai, yani joule (J).

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: K.E. = ½ mv² mein speed square hoti hai: speed dugni karein to K.E. chaar guna ho jati hai. Mass dugna karein to K.E. sirf dugni hoti hai.

blocks.title: Example 4.3
blocks.problem: 18620 N weight wali car 16 m s⁻¹ ki speed se chal rahi hai. Brake lagaye jate hain aur woh 80 m mein ruk jati hai. Us par lagne wali friction ki average force nikalein.
steps: Diya gaya: v = 16 m s⁻¹, d = 80 m, w = 18620 N, f = ?
Rukne se pehle car ki kinetic energy us ke kiye gaye work ke barabar hai: ½ mv² = f d
Pehle mass nikalein: m = w / g = 18620 N / 9.8 m s⁻² = 1900 kg
Qeematein rakhein: ½ × 1900 kg × (16 m s⁻¹)² = f × 80 m, yani 243 200 J = f × 80 m
